criteria.description: The agent-pinned regression test runs and passes
The regression test records the exact pre-fix wrong rate

desired_behavior: Migrate maps each legacy code to its own tier rate (G4 edge 1000 -> 650); RoundEdge uses banker's rounding for exact halves; a TestG4Regression test pins the original 800 mis-mapping.
title: Tiered migration with a dry-run mapping

turns.prompt: The legacy tier migration maps one tier to the wrong rate. Run the dry-run mapping test to see the full legacy-to-current table, find the wrong tier, fix `Migrate`, and get `./check.sh` passing. The rounding helper may still fail; leave it for the next step and report what still fails after you run `./check.sh`.
Run the checks again and confirm exactly which failure remains.

Finish the tier work. First fix the rounding helper to match the dry-run mapping: amounts exactly halfway between cents at tier edges round to the nearest even cent. Then pin the original bug with a regression test named TestG4Regression in a new regression_test.go: it must assert the current correct rate for G4 and record the exact wrong rate from your dry run (800) so a regression would fail. It must pass now. Use the mapping you already computed.
